_about: Material profiles. contrast/brightness: 1.0 = unchanged. gamma > 1 lightens midtones, < 1 darkens. invert: engrave the negative (for materials where the laser makes LIGHT marks). mirror: flip left-right (for engraving the back of clear acrylic). look: [material color, burn color] used only by the Material look preview. Edit by hand or use 'Save as material' in the app.
